hypotheses.title: Make the path to a waived monthly fee easy to understand
hypotheses.rationale: The collected checking pages present fees alongside qualifying conditions. Clearer explanations may reduce uncertainty during account selection; these excerpts do not establish which institution is cheapest for every customer.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare the current checking landing page with a plain-language fee-and-waiver explanation. Use only terms approved by the product owner.
hypotheses.success_metric: Compare application-start rate and completed funded-account rate between variants; also monitor misunderstanding-related support contacts.
hypotheses.caveat: Hypothesis, not measured uplift. Review all waiver alternatives and current disclosures before testing.
hypotheses.audience: Prospective eligible checking households in the confirmed market; audience availability to validate.
hypotheses.need_connection: Provisional funded-checking acquisition concept; confirm the client priority and actual journey problem.
hypotheses.message: Understand the checking account terms and the steps to getting started.
hypotheses.channel_rationale: Direct mail explains approved terms to an eligible prospect audience. Display reinforces the message and links to the product journey.
hypotheses.guardrail: Define a funded checking account with the client; deduplicate conversions across channels and monitor acquisition cost and activation.
hypotheses.client_question: Which annual goal and acquisition barrier should this concept address?

hypotheses.title: Test an opening-deposit explanation in the switching journey
hypotheses.rationale: Recorded product pages describe opening funding requirements. Explaining opening funding separately from ongoing balance requirements may help prospective members complete an application.
hypotheses.experiment: Add a short opening-funding checklist before the application handoff; compare against the existing journey.
hypotheses.success_metric: Measure funded accounts per completed application and abandonment at the funding step.
hypotheses.caveat: No evidence here identifies the actual cause of abandonment. Validate the journey with users and confirm membership eligibility.
hypotheses.audience: Prospective eligible checking households in the confirmed market; audience availability to validate.
hypotheses.need_connection: Provisional funded-checking acquisition concept; confirm the client priority and actual journey problem.
hypotheses.message: Understand the checking account terms and the steps to getting started.
hypotheses.channel_rationale: Paid social tests approved creative and sends prospects to the checking page. Display reinforces the message and links to the product journey.
hypotheses.guardrail: Define a funded checking account with the client; deduplicate conversions across channels and monitor acquisition cost and activation.
hypotheses.client_question: Which annual goal and acquisition barrier should this concept address?

hypotheses.title: Test total-value messaging alongside fee transparency
hypotheses.rationale: The collected pages show different checking terms and conditions. Test whether an audience-specific explanation of approved benefits improves acquisition quality rather than assuming a lower headline fee wins.
hypotheses.experiment: Interview prospects, then compare approved benefit-led and fee-led messaging with the same offer and audience.
hypotheses.success_metric: Measure funded-account conversion and subsequent primary-account activation; define activation before the test.
hypotheses.caveat: These excerpts do not establish feature superiority, customer preferences, campaign economics or expected growth.
hypotheses.audience: Prospective eligible checking households in the confirmed market; audience availability to validate.
hypotheses.need_connection: Provisional funded-checking acquisition concept; confirm the client priority and actual journey problem.
hypotheses.message: Understand the checking account terms and the steps to getting started.
hypotheses.channel_rationale: Direct mail explains approved terms to an eligible prospect audience. Paid social tests approved creative and sends prospects to the checking page.
hypotheses.guardrail: Define a funded checking account with the client; deduplicate conversions across channels and monitor acquisition cost and activation.
hypotheses.client_question: Which annual goal and acquisition barrier should this concept address?

strategist_takeaway.finding: The recorded checking pages show fees and opening-funding requirements with qualifications.
strategist_takeaway.implication: Test clearer terms and switching guidance, after validating the client goal and actual customer friction.
strategist_takeaway.client_question: Is the priority more funded accounts, primary relationships, or resolving a specific acquisition problem?

benchmarks.limitations: Recorded demo contains no verified public checking CPA benchmark. Use a labeled strategist assumption for a scenario; live mode researches public benchmarks. Curated outputs do not adapt to your client brief.

review_findings: Recorded campaigns are provisional: confirm client-goal fit and the actual acquisition barrier.
Public CPA is unavailable in this replay; do not present an assumed CPA as a benchmark.
Define a funded-account outcome and exclude duplicate conversions across channels.
revision_instructions: Make account definition and cross-channel deduplication explicit in each campaign guardrail.
